purpose: Reconciled visual audit of all frozen oracle suffix branches for DiT class 207 / global seed 2. This remains an exploratory mechanical repairability diagnostic and is not an online-method result.

review_scope.pass_rule: Remove the conspicuous fused or duplicated torso-tail defect while preserving one adult golden retriever, full-body standing pose, coarse orientation and placement, and snow or pale-ground composition. Mild residual imperfections do not fail unless they remain conspicuously below the model-relative cohort.

review_artifacts.layout: all-branch rows t=225,180,120,60; columns replay then fresh attempts 001..004

provisional_passes.reason: Both reviews agree: one adult golden retriever, coherent full-body standing anatomy, matching coarse orientation and placement on pale ground; the fused torso-tail mass is absent.

After enlarged comparison, the tail attaches to a recognizable rear torso and the hindquarters are substantially repaired while the same adult-dog pose, placement, and snow composition remain. It is no longer an obvious model-relative fusion failure.
Enlarged comparison shows a coherent rump, legs, and tail attachment with the adult subject, full-body standing pose, orientation, placement, and snowy composition preserved.

review_disagreement_and_resolution.initial_view: The first reviewer marked both as persistent fusion from the reduced all-branch sheet.
review_disagreement_and_resolution.independent_view: The second reviewer marked both as repaired while preserving semantics and composition.
review_disagreement_and_resolution.resolution: The first reviewer re-inspected an enlarged baseline-versus-branch sheet and agreed that the lateral form reads as a tail attached to a coherent rear torso, not the baseline shoulder-level duplicate mass. Both are upgraded to provisional pass.
review_disagreement_and_resolution.why_provisional: Only agent visual review has occurred; no formal blind human panel has adjudicated the images.

summary.time_window_interpretation: Very early t=225 and t=180 suffixes mostly replace identity, pose, or composition. At t=120 one suffix repairs the topology while retaining coarse semantics. Contrary to the initial low-resolution read, two t=60 suffixes can still clarify the rump-tail connection without changing the composition, although two other t=60 suffixes retain the defect.
summary.selection_warning: The 3/16 count is a descriptive oracle screen, not an estimator of an online intervention success probability and not a best-of-N method output.
summary.online_method_result: No. The frozen path-evidence detector did not trigger these rollback times and did not select these attempts.
